# direnv

> direnv is an environment switcher for the shell. It loads and unloads environment variables depending on the current directory, using an `.envrc` file to set up project-specific environments and tear them down when you leave.

Full documentation site: https://direnv.net

## Getting Started
- [Home](https://direnv.net/index.html)
- [Installation](https://direnv.net/docs/installation.html)
- [Hooking direnv into your shell](https://direnv.net/docs/hook.html)
